instruction: A candid outdoor full-body photograph shows a couple walking and talking on a sunny day. On the left, the blonde woman in the checkered dress (R2) walks forward, holding red roses and looking down with a smile. On the right, the man in the peach t-shirt (R1) walks beside her, gesturing with his left arm extended outward as he speaks. They walk hand-in-hand along a paved path. The scene is lit by bright, direct sunlight casting shadows on the ground, with green trees in the background.
elements: R1 gestures outward with his left arm while speaking as he walks hand-in-hand with R2
R2 carries red roses while walking hand-in-hand with R1
